instruction: Hotel Room Book Issue Set This task starts from init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png, init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited room book schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 10 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: LOBBY, BACK-OFFICE, GUEST-1, GUEST-2, GUEST-3, GUEST-4, GUEST-5, GUEST-6, GUEST-7, GUEST-8. 7. LOBBY, BACK-OFFICE, GUEST-1, GUEST-2, GUEST-3, GUEST-4 are assigned to one storey; and GUEST-5, GUEST-6, GUEST-7, GUEST-8 are assigned to a second storey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [20.0, 4.0, 6.6]. 9. Result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area. 10. Result.txt has exactly 10 data rows in this order: Z01 LOBBY 20.0, Z02 BACK-OFFICE 20.0, Z03 GUEST-1 20.0, Z04 GUEST-2 20.0, Z05 GUEST-3 20.0, Z06 GUEST-4 20.0, Z07 GUEST-5 20.0, Z08 GUEST-6 20.0, Z09 GUEST-7 20.0, Z10 GUEST-8 20.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10. 11. Result.pdf has exactly 3 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, HOTEL ROOM BOOK, LOBBY, BACK-OFFICE, GUEST-1, GUEST-8. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
